chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When the man has completed his Tawaf and prayed two Rak'ahs, let him go to Zamzam and draw water from it with a Dhanub or two Dhanubayn, then drink from it and pour it over his head, back, and stomach, saying: 'O Allah, make it beneficial knowledge, abundant sustenance, and healing from every disease and ailment.' Then let him return to the Black Stone.

key_terms.ذَنُوب: Dhanub (a specific type of water vessel)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice regarding Zamzam water after Tawaf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific Sunnah of drinking and pouring Zamzam water immediately after the two Rak'ahs of Tawaf, emphasizing its spiritual utility for knowledge, sustenance, and healing. The instruction to return to the Black Stone afterwards highlights the continuity of the ritual circuit, while the supplication reflects the Shia tradition of viewing Zamzam as a blessed medium for divine blessings (barakah) rather than merely a physical drink.
